notes.title: Hitch fix and other bugs
notes.notes:
Hey all!

This update fixes a hitching issue present in some spawn volumes. Gameplay should be much much smoother now. It also fixes the build button mismatch and a few other bugs related to offline play and the like. 

You will also notice polish here and there, its lookin better!

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Major performance boost - minor map changes.
notes.notes:
Hey guys! This update doubles the performance of the game. You should be getting double the frames you previously were getting.

I also made some changes to the map to increase frame rate and improve visibility. I will be updating the map more in the coming days.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Engine upgrade - Ferrobook update.
notes.notes:
Hi all! This update brings the game into a more modern engine version and sheds some of the bloat, which should lead to less or even, maybe, no more fatal errors. This update also makes some changes to the map and mainly the ferrobook, adding in silhouettes for unseen mons, a capture symbol for collected Ferromon, and publically listed evolution levels between all the listings.

The game may feel a bit slower than before, unfortunately unreal engine likes un-optimizing their engine with every update, making games harder to run even when nothing is changed. I will be working to attempt to undo their handiwork in this, but until then, expect a few less frames.

As always, thank you for playing!

notes.title: Some Monday night bug fixes :)
notes.notes:

notes.title: Content and bugs!
notes.notes:
This one adds more stuff to do and fixes yet, you guessed it, more bugs. I'll list a few:

-Notification Spacing
-Talk spamming an NPC breaking future battles
-Monument dungeon type quests not working
-Monument dungeon type chest being inaccessible
-NPC hostility issues in Castle dungeon type
-Dungeon ceiling collision
-Building uses double resources (sorry guys)
-Super long battle animations have been chopped
-Gondola stair collision
-Frame stutter in forest (too many trees)
-Mineral skill drive shop not working
-Small Emergence stone inability to be picked up
-Crunched all notifs into the notif system
-Balancing issues in the Mineral area
-And much, much more

Also!
-Added theme music + new title screen
-Added Surrender button to NPC fights
-Added even more dungeon instances, with more to come as I actually play the game and fill the boring parts

As always, thank you for playing! 1.0 will release as soon as I finish this playthrough balance (and every known bug and the 1.0 trailer). There are a few known bugs I am currently working on, and I will try to sort those out stat!

notes.title: Bug Fix - Jaming patch. Balancing, ect.
notes.notes:
This update fixes like, 3 pages of bugs that I really don't want to type out. Most of them had to do with UI sizing and battle functionality. Getting close to about done. 

Next up is making the mini-map less ugly, then I'm going to do a final continuous playthrough of it myself to identify the final balance and feel that I want.

notes.title: More Dungeons
notes.notes: Hey guys! Two more dungeon types are rolling out today. This brings us to around 27 dungeons (3 types, all instanced). I will be adding more in the coming days, as well as more balance and polish.

notes.title: Friday Hotfix
notes.notes:
Just a few fixes:

Makes monsters and trainers despawn near builds
Makes trainers despawn when close to another battle (to fix aggressive NPC battle crowding)

notes.title: Achievements (And Dungeons)
notes.notes:
Hey guys! new update out today

Among the usual bug fixes, this update adds 21 steam achievements. I will most likely add some fun ones later, but for now it's pretty basic milestones.

This update also adds a new dungeon structure into a few places across the map. I really want to fill up the world and reward exploration, so there will be more and more points of interest and things to do in the coming weeks.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Item tab in Ferrobook
notes.notes:
Hey guys! This is mostly a bug fix update, but it also adds a primitive version of the Item compendium. This feature allows you to search and read up on crafting ingredients in the game and aims to eliminate confusion surrounding where to get things. It has become clear to me that the game needs more handholding, so I will be adding more of that sort of thing.

As always, thank you for playing during early access!

notes.title: Quests, bugs, and Emotes
notes.notes:
I would attempt to list the entire changelog, but honestly, I've forgotten. Here's the big stuff:

Content:
-Added more side quests and made it easier to continue to add content.
-Added life and things to do to all current in game POIs
-Added the emote system, so you can jam out with friends and have a silly time
-Added /tpa to teleport to your friends and keep the experience as co-op as possible

Bugs:
-Fixes the audio system long-term session breakage
-Fixed build dependency woes
-Added /endbattle to sort out any weird battles that softlock on occasion while I work on the root cause
-Fixed NPC party generation causing more complex areas to crash 
-Significantly increased multiplayer performance for both host and client
-Stabilized controller and fixed crafting issues
-Fixed low-level mons being unable to evolve with the new build system
-Many, many more

World:
-Added a working Gondola, so players have the option to opt out of scaling the volcano
-Added visual areas of interest, waterfalls and the like
-Added many NPCS to talk to
-More that I am sure I am forgetting.

While I had hoped to have 1.0 out in time for the monster festival, and I feel it is very solid right now, I refuse to release this out of 1.0 until I am very confident in its integrity. Expect more updates filling out the empty world space. Hopefully I can hammer this out soon!

notes.title: Translation Update!
notes.notes:
Rolling out translations for Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, and Spanish tonight. Not everything is currently translated, more and more will get done as time goes on, but it's at probably 90% right now? 

Update also fixes a bunch of bugs per usual, new game builds persisting, a few menu bugs, and changes around how quests work. 

Please be on the lookout and alert me of any bugs that occur due to the translated version. I had to change a lot of data to all conform to Unreal Engine's localization tool, so we may run into some issues, especially having to do with quests, crafting, and building. Please bear with me and submit bug reports! Thank you!

Anyone who previously was playing with an epic games account during the steam auth blackout - if the update seems to clear your data or set you back, just link your steam account to your epic games account in the title screen and it should fix 🙂

notes.title: Optimization and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Sorry I have not been doing as changelogs, as you may have noticed, the updates are nonetheless still rolling out.

We are aiming to be at 1.0 release by May 12th and are making steady progress towards that goal. This update takes a lot of the bloat out and makes some serious frame improvements.

It is to be noted that graphically, it won't look quite as good after this update, but I've gone from averaging 60 Frames on high settings to around 300, and since this game is meant to be extremely accessible, I have decided the sacrifice is worth it (don't worry, its honestly not even very noticeable, and future updates will smooth things over). The minimap is rough around the edges, as I replaced it with my own code for compatibility reasons, but it will improve in the coming days.

This update also handles a large number of bugs, I honestly forgot which ones since it's been a while, but I think I've got all reported bugs handled as of this update.

Those of you in the discord know how the android version is panning out, and as stated there, I'm shifting focus to make the pc version as solid as possible prior to May 12th and then worrying about the little screen.

Up next is more content, cutscenes, translation, and some final touches. Keep sending those bug reports!!!!

Thanks!

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.notes:
Hi guys! this update rolls out controller support and fixes a bunch of bugs! Let me know if you have any issues with any of the new systems or menus.

Thanks for playing!!!!

notes.title: Final Building System (polish pending)
notes.notes:
Final build system is out! Your important free build placeables will be rolled over to the new system, while free build walls and platforms will disappear in favor of the snap build system- per community vote.

The new system lacks a bit of polish but is much better than anything prior. I don't foresee many functionality complaints going forward.

CHANGES:

New build system accessible with Q. Place all items under the snap build system.

As-you-go crafting allows you to pay for builds as you build them, instead of having to go through the crafting menu

Removal of radial snap build menu in favor of a far more modular and organized approach to accommodate all the new snap builds.

There are some known bugs (can't close build menu with escape or q, visual menu glitching, ect) per usual these will get ironed out in near future bug fixes. 

Keep sending bug reports! and thank you all for playing!

notes.title: Halloween Event! 30 New Ferromon!
notes.notes:
It's a festive time in Ferromon Together! A new town, Ravenwood, has popped up. Use any teleporter to teleport to this limited time experience. Catch Candybatts to trade with the locals and explore the town meeting all sorts of wacky characters.

Along with the event, 30 new Ferromon have been added to the game! Aside from the limited time monsters available for trade in the Ravenwood mansion, they will slowly start showing up in the world over the next week or so.

As always, thank you for playing during early access!

notes.title: October 24th
notes.notes:
Hey guys! This update fixes two big problems with the build system

-Fixes the inability to free-build on top of snap-built structures.

This is the final update before the Halloween update!

notes.title: Day/Night cycle beggining
notes.notes:
Hey guys! this is mostly a backend/bug patch. It fixes more UI issues and fixes some messy code causing some project data to be stored in the engine (not good). 

However, this update also includes the day/night cycle! It's cosmetic for now, but I will be adding more to it in the coming weeks.

Keep your eyes out for an update fixing some of the building issues as well, since that is my next target.

ETA on Halloween update is the 27th.

notes.title: UI stability and balancing
notes.notes:
A small update that adds further UI stability, more early game balancing, and a whole lot of smaller bugs here and there.

This is the final bug patch prior to a very large festive update. Keep your eyes out for the update to drop!

notes.title: Building system improvements, bugs, no more character pixelation.
notes.notes:
This update fixes multiple issues, especially regarding link battles, which still need a bit of work.

The building system now allows for floating foundations, so building bridges will be much more tolerable

I've removed the pixel art filter that was applied to the characters. Originally this stood to help bridge the art gap, but the general consensus has been to find a different approach, and so I will.

As always, thank you for all for playing in early access and helping me see this through!

notes.title: New Building System, Art, Stability, and a step towards 1.0
notes.notes:
Huge update here today guys. This has been a few weeks worth of work in art, bugs, stability, features, and performance. I'm extremely thankful for every bug report that helps me work out these issues I've missed.

Look forward to a Halloween event coming soon! Along with much more solid content as I get closer to fleshing out the backend.

notes.title: September 3rd: Stability
notes.notes:
This update fixes over 100 bugs that the community worked together to find. It may also introduce a few new ones, but we are net positive for sure! 

The update also includes some new music that I made myself and some lighting changes to preemptively compliment new foliage, as I move to phase out epic game assets in favor of a game 100% created by me (and my support artists :)

This update should leave the game in a stable state where I can begin tearing apart the building and vehicle system and rebuild them to be up to par with my players expectations. Wish me luck! 
aiming for 1.0 release on Halloween (if we're lucky!) and a Halloween event to go with it.
